responsibility: Validates SCC construction and annotation propagation across diverse graph shapes, including single and multiple components, deep chains, cycles, regression cases, and the resulting SCC graph structure and metadata.
same_name_distinction: Within the graph `tests.rs` group, this file is the SCC-focused suite, covering component formation, SCC indices, condensed successor edges, deep recursion/regression cases, and even an SCC benchmark, not general traversal or adjacency APIs.
